name: comp-477
blurb: Table with multi-select checkboxes and column totals.
description: Data table with checkbox column for selecting individual rows and all rows, displaying user data with status badges and currency-formatted balance. Includes footer row showing total balance.
use_when: Displaying selectable data records where users need to select multiple rows and see aggregate totals.
avoid_when: Static data only — data fetches from hardcoded URL, not configurable for other datasets.
a11y: Checkboxes have aria-labels for "Select row" and "Select all". Indeterminate state handles partial selection.
